text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
After undergoing an ultra-evolution from 
the boundless emotional high of the Senior 
Spring GⅠ campaign, Digi-tan is finally 
set for the showdown with Opera O-san and 
Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I want an all-out clash of raw ability on 
a stage where both can give their absolute 
best...! If so, a turf medium-distance 
race is the only choice!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Next Episode: 《Clash! The Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)》 Now, the challenge evolves.
